feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 August 2026 10:45am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 17 August 2026 at 10:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the mid-Atlantic, various fronts affecting the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, becoming west or southwest 3 or 4 this afternoon, then south-southwest 4 or 5 during this evening. Veering west overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight to moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Patchy drizzle and mist at first, then outbreaks of rain developing later this afternoon & evening, largely clearing overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in places.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, backing southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
